deliverer: the sea cave (climb the stair to the top landing)
scatter: polar disc r 8 m about the anchor (oracle: theta = 2 pi u1, rho = 8 u2); every 'ground' segment covers it

camera.law: screen_x = ppm*x ; screen_y = ppm*sin(a)*y - ppm*cos(a)*z (sim frame: x east, y SOUTH, z up)
camera.runtime_scale_rule: draw each cell UNROTATED with its pivot_px on the projected pivot point, scaled by s = proj.ppm / px_per_m (the JOIN rule; at ZOOM-GD proj.ppm = 75.668)

draw_layer.note: the lip is SOUTH of the patch (toward the camera): the spray y-sorts IN FRONT of bodies; it rises from the cliff face below the lip (z < 0) and dies where it falls onto the land

events.start: EV_POINT_RELEASE(p03): play 'intro' once from its frame 0
events.hold: then repeat 'loop' until EV_POINT_RELEASE_DONE(p03) + 0.8 s (STRETCHABLE: whole loops; the release window comes from the runtime's two-segment release warp)
events.min_hold: intro + one full loop, even if the release is instantaneous
events.end: fade modulate.a 1 -> 0 over 1.0 s while the loop keeps playing; then free

segments.draw_layer: ground: above the painted floor, BELOW every y-sorted actor

events.start: EV_POINT_RELEASE(p03): start the loop at frame 0 and fade modulate.a 0 -> 1 over 0.6 s
events.end: fade modulate.a 1 -> 0 over 1.5 s; then free

draw_layer.ysort_ground_m: the body's own landing point + 0.05 m south (drawn just in front of its own body)

events.start: EV_BODY_SPAWN(p03, body, x, y): one-shot at the body's rolled landing point (theta = 2 pi u1, rho = 8 u2 about the anchor), frame 0 on the spawn tick -- frame 0 is dense on purpose: it covers the body's pop-in
events.scale: x max(1, record_radius_m / 0.8) for bodies wider than 1.6 m (true_size packs)

deliverer_feature: the cliff lip on the origin -> p03 ray, 9.2 m out from the anchor (the stair's top landing edge)
